# Ravin Nallasamy

Full-stack & AI engineer based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Builds
full-stack products and the AI systems inside them — MERN, Flutter, and
RAG pipelines that actually ship. Open to freelance work, working globally.

## Notable projects

- AI HR System — candidate/HR portals with AI-generated follow-up questions and fit scoring.
- Ravin-Assistant — a RAG bot that answers interview questions about Ravin, grounded in his own resume and GitHub.
- Uzhavan Rentals — a two-sided marketplace letting farmers rent equipment from nearby owners.
- Cerina Protocol Foundry — a multi-agent LangGraph system that drafts and reviews clinical protocols with human approval.
- Heart Patient Management App / TumoCare — Flutter apps tracking vitals and medication for heart and brain-tumor patients.
